items.raw_excerpt: El cuadro cruzado visita a los cementeros en el "Nicolás Chahuán". La revancha será el sábado en el Claro Arena.
items.summary_en: In the Copa Chile cup, Universidad Católica is a weaker side on paper. The team wants to use its recent good form when it plays La Calera. The game is on Saturday at Claro Arena. The stadium sits near the Nicolas Chahuan cemetery, a known landmark in the area.
items.summary_ko: 코파길에서 UC는 라 칼레라를 상대로 최근의 좋은 흐름을 이어가려 한다. 다음 경기는 토요일에 클라로 아레나에서 열린다. 경기장은 니콜라스 차우안 공동묘지 근처에 자리한 곳이다.
items.title_en: A weak UC side wants to keep its good run against La Calera
items.title_ko: 코파길에서 UC 약팀, 라 칼레라전 연속 좋흘 노려
items.title_original: Una mermada UC quiere aprovechar el impulso liguero ante La Calera en la Copa Chile

items.summary_en: The Mega-Sena lottery did not have a winner. The next draw is on Thursday at 8 pm Brasília time. The prize for that draw is now about 38 million reais.

items.raw_excerpt: The City of Perth sacks its chief executive officer Michelle Reynolds, who had been suspended from her job since May.
items.summary_en: The City of Perth has sacked its chief executive, Michelle Reynolds. She had been suspended from her job since May. The city council says the decision ends months of turmoil at the council.

items.title_en: City of Perth Sacks Its Chief Executive
items.title_original: Breaking: City of Perth plunged into more turmoil as CEO sacked

items.raw_excerpt: Christchurch's cash-strapped Orana Wildlife Park has been given a $1.2 million lifeline from ratepayers, with neighbouring councils also urged to chip in.
items.summary_en: Orana Wildlife Park in Christchurch received $1.2 million from city ratepayers so it can keep running. The park was short of money and needed help. Nearby councils have also been asked to chip in.
items.summary_ko: 크라이스츠차의 오라나 야생동물공원이 도시 세금 120만 달러를 지원부탬 문을 닫지 않고 이어 갈 수 히었습니다. 공원은 어맞 전까지 재정난로 상에 있었습니다. 좋뤬의 다른 시·군에도 함께 도를 내다는 요청이 이어가나와 있습니다.
items.title_en: Orana Wildlife Park Gets $1.2m Ratepayer Bailout
items.title_ko: 오라나 야생동물공원, 세금 120만 달러 진지 용
items.title_original: Orana Wildlife Park gets $1.2m ratepayer bailout

items.raw_excerpt: Irin Gan, who played eldest Tay daughter Vicky in the 1990s drama Growing Up, recently reunited with her onscreen parents Lim Kay Tong and Wee Soon Hui.
items.summary_en: Irin Gan recently met her onscreen parents Lim Kay Tong and Wee Soon Hui. They played her family in the 1990s Singapore drama Growing Up. Fans are feeling nostalgic about the old show.
items.summary_ko: 이린 갠이 1990년 싱가포르 드라마에서 함께 출연했던 임 kay 퐁과 위 순 회와 최근 다시 만났습니다. 이 셋은 드라마에서 가족로 출연했습니다. 팬들은 옛 드라마에 대한 향수를 느낀다고 말합니다.
items.title_en: Irin Gan Meets Her Growing Up Parents Again

items.raw_excerpt: Phuket local and rising global star Nene Royal lit up the stage with a rendition of The White Stripes' ' Seven Nation Army ' in the final round of America's Got Talent 2026 , as she vied for the competition's coveted title, which was due to be announced on Thursday.
items.summary_en: Nene Royal comes from Phuket in Thailand. She sang Seven Nation Army by The White Stripes in the final round of America's Got Talent 2026. The winner was to be announced on Thursday.
items.summary_ko: 네네 로얄은 태국 푸켓 출신의 신예 가수다. 2026년 미국 텔레비전 경연대회 결승에서 화이트 스트라이프즈의 세븐 네이션 아미를 불렀다. 우승자 발표는 목요일로 예정돼 있다.
items.title_en: Phuket singer Nene Royal sings in America's Got Talent final

items.title_original: Nene Royal rocks AGT final with 'Seven Nation Army'
